label: MACHO/MACHO
name: MACHO Project
description: The MACHO Project searched for gravitational microlensing by massive compact halo objects, monitoring the Large and Small Magellanic Clouds and the Galactic Bulge with the 1.27 m Great Melbourne Telescope at Mount Stromlo from 1992 to 1999. This catalog holds one row per star for the whole survey, combining positions and the variability statistics of the MACHO star statistics table with the full two-colour light curve, nested under the lc column.

notes.title: Light Curves
notes.content: Light curves are in the lc column. Blue and red are observed simultaneously, so both bands share one epoch row. Magnitudes are instrumental; we added per-star Kron-Cousins kv and kr following Alcock+99.
